title: Your Farm Records, Connected
description: Explore how notes, photos, and dated records help you keep track of field work and prepare reports.

image.alt: Connected Farm Data Ecosystem Aerial Map

insights.title: Record What You See in the Field
insights.label: Field Observations
insights.description: Record field conditions in a voice note or photo, even offline. Sync when connected, then review and confirm the captured details.

image.alt: Record What You See in the Field

insights.title: Trace Records Back to Each Field
insights.label: Field Records
insights.description: Keep dated tasks, input records, and receipts linked to the field they belong to, so you can find the record behind each activity.

image.alt: Trace Records Back to Each Field

insights.title: Preserve the Story Behind the Numbers
insights.label: Field Diary & Story
insights.description: Say what happened in the field and turn it into a dated task. Review and confirm the details, keeping the context behind the record.

image.alt: Preserve the Story Behind the Numbers

insights.title: Prepare Audit-Ready Records
insights.label: Audit-Ready Records
insights.description: Find records linked to your land, select a template, and generate a report. Review and confirm the details before your certification review.

insights.title: Built Around Your Farm
insights.label: Farm Organization
insights.description: Organize notes, photos, and paper logs by farm, field, plot, and subplot, using the names and boundaries you already know.
